explanation.headline: Losartan potassium is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; current supply covers 10.6 to 26.3 days and the top alternate manufacturer is Macleods Pharmaceuticals Limited with a VAI inspection on 2023-10-20

sentences.text: FDA's records show losartan potassium is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 113 tablets of the 25 mg presentation at 10.6 tablets per day, providing 10.6 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 361 tablets of the 25 mg presentation at 13.7 tablets per day, providing 26.3 days on hand.

The rule-based alternate manufacturer ranked first is Macleods Pharmaceuticals Limited, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and its plant was last inspected with a VAI classification on 2023-10-20.
A second alternate is Strides Pharma Science Limited, also not on the shortage list, with its plant Strides Alathur Private Limited last inspected VAI on 2024-04-05.
A third alternate is AiPing Pharmaceutical, Inc., not on the shortage list, but its label names no plant that could be placed.
Check current inventory against the 10.6- and 26.3-day projections and qualify the Macleods source for immediate purchase.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
